metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code present (Timesheet.aspx.vb with VB.NET code-behind serving HTTP endpoints via ASP.NET WebForms) with a persistent data store (SQL Server). Single deployable unit with no library packaging. Classified as application.
metadata.archetype_justification: Database connections with write operations (INSERT INTO timesheets) and read operations (SELECT FROM timesheets) via SqlClient. Owns persistent state in SQL Server. No multi-service orchestration, no event consumption, not read-only. Classified as stateful-crud.

findings.title: Managed Compute — All compute on unsupported IIS 6 / Windows Server 2003
findings.description: All compute runs on a single IIS 6 instance on Windows Server 2003. No managed container orchestration (ECS/EKS), no serverless (Lambda), no Fargate.
findings.gap: No managed compute services in use. The hosting platform (Windows Server 2003, IIS 6) is end-of-life and cannot be patched.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to managed compute: containerize the application on ECS/Fargate (after .NET upgrade) or rebuild as Lambda functions behind API Gateway.

findings.title: Managed Databases — Self-managed SQL Server 2005
findings.description: Database is a self-managed SQL Server 2005 instance at IP 10.0.6.15. No managed database service (RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB) in use.
findings.gap: Self-managed SQL Server requires manual patching, backup management, and scaling. SQL Server 2005 is past end-of-life.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Amazon RDS for SQL Server as a first step. Long-term, evaluate Aurora PostgreSQL for cost optimization.

findings.title: Workflow Orchestration — No orchestration service detected
findings.description: No workflow orchestration service detected. The application performs simple CRUD operations with no multi-step workflow management.
findings.gap: No orchestration capability for potential multi-step business processes (timesheet approval workflows).
findings.recommendation: When modernizing, implement AWS Step Functions for any multi-step business processes.

findings.title: Async Messaging and Streaming — No messaging infrastructure
findings.description: No messaging or streaming infrastructure. All operations synchronous. For a stateful-crud service, async messaging would be appropriate for cross-service state change notifications.
findings.gap: No messaging where state changes could benefit from cross-service notification.
findings.recommendation: Introduce Amazon SQS or EventBridge for cross-service notifications when integrating with downstream systems.

findings.title: Network Security — No VPC or network segmentation
findings.description: No VPC, security groups, NACLs, or network segmentation. Application connects to database at bare IP with no encryption in transit.
findings.gap: No network segmentation between application and database. No encryption in transit.
findings.recommendation: Deploy in a VPC with private subnets for the database tier. Implement security groups with least-privilege rules. Enable HTTPS.

findings.title: API Entry Point — No gateway or load balancer
findings.description: No API Gateway, ALB, CloudFront, or load balancer. Application exposed directly via IIS 6 with no throttling or request validation.
findings.gap: Services exposed directly with no gateway or load balancer.
findings.recommendation: Place an ALB or API Gateway in front of the application for throttling, SSL termination, and health checks.

findings.title: Auto-Scaling — No auto-scaling configured
findings.description: No auto-scaling. Single IIS 6 server with static capacity.
findings.gap: All capacity statically provisioned. Cannot respond to traffic spikes.
findings.recommendation: After containerization, configure ECS service auto-scaling with target tracking.

findings.title: Backup and Recovery — No backup configuration
findings.description: No backup configuration found. Self-managed SQL Server 2005 may have manual backup procedures but no evidence exists in this repository.
findings.gap: No automated backup configuration. No retention periods. No tested restore procedures.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS for automated backups with configurable retention. Enable PITR.

findings.title: Infrastructure as Code Coverage — No IaC
findings.description: No infrastructure as code found. No Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, Helm, or Kustomize. All infrastructure manually created.
findings.gap: 0% IaC coverage. All infrastructure manually provisioned.
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure in IaC using CloudFormation or CDK. Start with database, networking, and compute.

findings.title: CI/CD Automation — No CI/CD pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD configuration found. Deployment is manual VS publish to network share.
findings.gap: No CI/CD automation. All deployments are manual.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD with CodePipeline + CodeBuild. Define stages: source → build → test → deploy.

findings.title: Programming Languages — VB.NET on .NET Framework 2.0 (compound legacy)
findings.description: VB.NET on .NET Framework 2.0 with ASP.NET WebForms. Compound-legacy: language runtime past EOL, web framework is legacy, AWS SDK not supported on .NET 2.0.
findings.gap: .NET Framework 2.0 not supported by AWS SDK. WebForms has no cloud-native equivalent. Requires framework upgrade before AWS integration.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to .NET 8 with ASP.NET Core. VB.NET supported on .NET 8 but C# recommended for ecosystem access.

findings.title: Monolith vs Microservices — Tightly-coupled monolith
findings.description: Tightly-coupled monolith. Single code-behind file contains UI handling, business logic, and data access all intermixed. SQL queries built inline with string concatenation in button click handlers.
findings.gap: Pervasive coupling — UI, business logic, and data access inseparable. No module boundaries.
findings.recommendation: Refactor into layers: extract data access layer, separate business logic from UI handlers. See Decomposition Strategy.

findings.title: Async vs Sync Communication — All synchronous
findings.description: All communication synchronous HTTP. WebForms page performs synchronous database operations. No async patterns. For a stateful-crud service, async would be appropriate for state change notifications.
findings.gap: All communication synchronous with no async patterns.
findings.recommendation: Introduce async patterns for cross-service communication using SQS/EventBridge.

findings.title: Long-Running Process Handling — All operations synchronous
findings.description: All operations synchronous regardless of duration. No background job processing, no status polling, no async job framework.
findings.gap: No async job processing capability. All operations block HTTP request thread.
findings.recommendation: Implement async job processing for potentially long-running operations using SQS + Lambda workers or Step Functions.

findings.title: API Versioning Strategy — No versioning
findings.description: No API versioning strategy. Single WebForms page with no REST API, no versioned endpoints.
findings.gap: No versioning — any change affects all users immediately.
findings.recommendation: When modernizing to REST API, implement URL-path versioning from the start.

findings.title: Service Discovery — Hard-coded IP addresses
findings.description: Database connection string contains hardcoded IP address (10.0.6.15). No service registry, no DNS-based discovery.
findings.gap: Hard-coded IP address. Any infrastructure change requires code/config change and redeployment.
findings.recommendation: Externalize endpoints using environment variables or Parameter Store. Use RDS DNS endpoints.

findings.title: Unstructured Data Storage — No managed object storage
findings.description: No S3 or managed object storage. All data in SQL Server relational database. No document parsing capability.
findings.gap: No managed object storage for unstructured data.
findings.recommendation: If document uploads needed, migrate to S3 with lifecycle policies. Add Textract for data extraction.

findings.title: Unified Data Access Layer — Scattered inline SQL
findings.description: No unified data access layer. Inline SqlClient queries with string concatenation in UI code-behind. SQL injection vulnerability present.
findings.gap: Data access completely unstructured — SQL queries embedded in UI event handlers.
findings.recommendation: Extract data access into repository/DAO layer. Use parameterized queries immediately to fix SQL injection.

findings.title: Database Engine Version and EOL — SQL Server 2005 (10+ years past EOL)
findings.description: SQL Server 2005 reached end of extended support in April 2016. No security patches available. No version pinning in IaC.
findings.gap: Database engine 10+ years past EOL. Critical security and compliance gap.
findings.recommendation: Migrate immediately to supported SQL Server on RDS (2019 or 2022). Use AWS DMS for data migration.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest — No encryption configured
findings.description: No encryption at rest. SQL Server 2005 does not support TDE. No KMS keys. Employee data stored unencrypted.
findings.gap: No encryption at rest for database. Employee timesheet data stored without encryption.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to RDS for SQL Server (2019+) with encryption at rest using AWS KMS.

findings.title: API Authentication — Forms auth without SSL (not token-based)
findings.description: Forms authentication configured but cookie-based (not OAuth2/JWT). requireSSL=false means auth cookie transmitted in cleartext.
findings.gap: Authentication not token-based. Auth cookie vulnerable to interception (no SSL).
findings.recommendation: Migrate to OAuth2/JWT with Amazon Cognito. Enable HTTPS immediately.

findings.title: Centralized Identity Integration — Standalone Forms auth
findings.description: Application manages own authentication with Forms auth. No centralized IdP integration (no Cognito, Okta, SAML/OIDC).
findings.gap: Standalone authentication with no centralized IdP. Cannot enforce SSO policies.
findings.recommendation: Integrate with Amazon Cognito or existing corporate IdP. Enable SSO.

findings.title: Secrets Management — Plaintext credentials in web.config
findings.description: Plaintext credentials committed to source control: User ID=ts_app;Password=Time2006! in web.config. Critical security vulnerability.
findings.gap: Database credentials in plaintext in version-controlled config. Active vulnerability.
findings.recommendation: IMMEDIATE: Rotate credentials. Store in AWS Secrets Manager with rotation. Remove from git history.

findings.title: Compute Hardening and Patching — Unpatchable platform
findings.description: Windows Server 2003 and IIS 6 are end-of-life and cannot be patched. No vulnerability scanning.
findings.gap: Compute platform unpatchable. Known unpatched vulnerabilities. Active security risk.
findings.recommendation: Migrate off Windows Server 2003. Deploy on modern compute with managed patching (ECS, Lambda). Enable Inspector.

findings.title: Application Security Pipeline — No security scanning
findings.description: No SAST, dependency scanning, or container scanning. No CI/CD pipeline to integrate security tools. Known SQL injection persists undetected.
findings.gap: No security scanning. Known vulnerabilities persist.
findings.recommendation: Integrate SAST (CodeGuru/Semgrep) and dependency scanning into CI/CD pipeline.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing — No tracing instrumented
findings.description: No X-Ray, OpenTelemetry, or trace ID propagation. No observability instrumentation of any kind.
findings.gap: No tracing capability. Cannot trace requests or diagnose failures.
findings.recommendation: After .NET upgrade, instrument with X-Ray SDK or OpenTelemetry .NET SDK.

findings.title: SLO Definitions — No SLOs defined
findings.description: No SLO definitions, no CloudWatch alarms, no monitoring artifacts.
findings.gap: No formal SLOs. Cannot measure service health.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs for availability, latency, error rate. Implement CloudWatch alarms.

findings.title: Business Metrics — No custom metrics
findings.description: No custom metrics published. No business outcome tracking.
findings.gap: No business metrics. Cannot measure outcomes.
findings.recommendation: Publish custom CloudWatch metrics for business outcomes (timesheets_submitted, errors).

findings.title: Anomaly Detection and Alerting — No alerting
findings.description: No alerting configured. No CloudWatch alarms, no anomaly detection. Failures detected by user reports.
findings.gap: No alerting. Service failures go undetected.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms on error rates and latency. Enable anomaly detection.

findings.title: Integration Testing — No automated tests
findings.description: No integration tests, no unit tests, no test frameworks, no test configuration.
findings.gap: Zero test coverage. Any change carries high regression risk.
findings.recommendation: Add integration tests for critical paths. Use xUnit/NUnit. Run in CI pipeline.

findings.title: Observability Ownership — No observability exists
findings.description: No CODEOWNERS, no dashboards, no alarms with owners. No monitoring exists to own.
findings.gap: No observability ownership. Monitoring entirely absent.
findings.recommendation: When implementing observability, define ownership from start with CODEOWNERS and team attribution.
